from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its own title and which OTHER provided papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) found in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
